results.text:
Day hike checklist
Two liters of water and electrolyte tablets

Rain shell and a warm fleece layer
Headlamp with spare batteries

Offline map and a paper map with compass
First-aid kit, blister plasters and sunscreen

Tell someone your route and expected return time before you leave.

Residential Lease Agreement

This agreement is made between the landlord, Harbor Properties LLC, and the tenant for the apartment at 42 Seaview Road.
The monthly rent is 2,400 dollars, due on the first day of each month. A late fee of 75 dollars applies after the fifth day.
The security deposit equals one month of rent and will be returned within 30 days after move-out, minus any damages.
Pets are allowed with prior written consent and an additional pet deposit of 500 dollars.
The tenant may terminate early with 60 days notice and payment of one month's rent as a break fee.

results.text:
Solar Panel Efficiency in Cold Climates
Abstract. Photovoltaic modules are often assumed to perform poorly in winter, ye t lower cell temperatures increase open-circuit voltage and conversion efficiency. We measured twelve rooftop insta llations in northern Norway over two years.
Results. Snow cover was the dominant source of loss, reducing annual yield by 9 percent on low-tilt roofs. Panels mounted at 60 degrees shed snow quickly and produced 14 percent more ener gy per installed kilowatt than identical panels in southern Spain during clear spring days, thanks to cold temp eratures and reflected light from snow (albedo).
Conclusion. Steep mounting angles and bifacial modules are recommended for high- latitude installations.
